body: On what version of the website are you? I'm on Version 8.1.1-local+sha.4bda80003. and I see it fine. Same version of Chrome.

I suspect this is an issue with a specific fallback font (specified [here][1] and used [there][2]).
This has been brought up again in the past: #20382

@tzvipm (or anyone else): Would you be interested in implementing the changes suggested in https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/20382#discussion_r150487492?
(And/Or verify that they fix the problem for you?)

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/6aaca21c27f0e220e2ec59b7ea46d20e1a70a597/aio/src/styles/_constants.scss#L2
[2]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/6aaca21c27f0e220e2ec59b7ea46d20e1a70a597/aio/src/styles/0-base/_typography.scss#L6
I was able to reproduce the bug locally on the latest master branch. I can take a look at #20382 and see if that fixes the issue :+1:

@gkalpak, The suggestion in https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/20382#discussion_r150487492 seems to work, but the button text looks vertically misaligned:

![angularIoDisplayBugSuggestedFix](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1950680/60904661-65712a80-a241-11e9-906b-8a06c1ab1adb.png)

Getting rid of the explicit `height` as well fixes that issue:

![angularIoDisplayBugSuggestedFixNoHeight](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1950680/60904674-6a35de80-a241-11e9-99e7-2377066dcd2a.png)

I'll put up a PR shortly
